planned_by: Claude (Critic): blueprint §15/§17 — make each verified change visible as a graph
goal:
T42 — draw each mission's evidence chain as an intuitive graph on the Evidence page.

GET /v1/evidence/{id} returns chain: [{stage, event_id}] in order (ObjectiveVersion, Task, Candidate, Gate, Review, PR,
Outcome; event_id null when the stage has not happened) and, for gate/run evidence, gates: [{gate, result, reason}].
1. NEW apps/web/lib/evidenceGraph.ts (pure, no imports except `import type`): export
   buildEvidenceGraph(chain, gates) -> {nodes: [{stage, label, status: "done"|"blocked"|"missing", detail, href}],
   edges: [{from, to}]}. Nodes keep chain order; status "missing" when event_id is null; the Gate node is "blocked"
   when any gate result is not PASS (detail names those gates and results), "done" when all PASS; href is
   `/evidence?id=<event_id>` (null when missing). Edges connect consecutive stages. Empty chain -> no nodes, no edges.
2. NEW apps/web/components/EvidenceGraph.tsx: inline SVG (no new dependency), left-to-right flow that wraps to two rows
   at 375px; nodes as rounded rectangles with stage label + short status, colors by status from the theme tokens
   (done / blocked / missing clearly distinct, missing drawn dashed), animated edge reveal that respects
   prefers-reduced-motion, every node has <title>/aria-label text and is a link when href is set; legend below.
3. apps/web/app/[locale]/evidence/page.tsx renders <EvidenceGraph> above the existing details, using
   buildEvidenceGraph(evidence.chain, evidence.gates ?? []).
4. Strings in messages/ko.json and messages/en.json (identical keys). Do not change API code.
